Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted PBS’s wording “died … in his home on the island of Faro, Sweden,” incorrectly equating “Faro” with Faro, Portugal. This ignored the explicit “Sweden” in the source and the common transliteration of Fårö (Sweden) as “Faro,” leading to a wrong geographical conclusion.
